scenarios.name: complete_adventure_flow
scenarios.description: Test the complete user journey from start to first location

conversation.content: Hello! I want to start an adventure.
Welcome! I'm your game master. Let me transfer you to our persona specialist to understand your preferences.
I'm in San Francisco, love adventurous local secrets, have a weekend free, and it's currently 2 PM Saturday.
Perfect! I have your preferences. Let me find you a mysterious location...

expected_behaviors: Game master greets and explains adventure
Returns to game master with preferences

scenarios.name: multi_location_adventure
scenarios.description: Test handling multiple locations in sequence

conversation.content: I found the first location! It was amazing. What's next?

expected_behaviors: Offers to find next mystery location
Uses planning to find another location

scenarios.name: preference_refinement
scenarios.description: Test ability to refine preferences based on feedback

conversation.content: That location was too touristy. I want something more off the beaten path.

expected_behaviors: Adjusts preferences toward more local/hidden spots

scenarios.name: help_during_search
scenarios.description: Test providing help when user is stuck finding location

conversation.content: I've been searching for 20 minutes and can't figure out the hint. Can you help?

expected_behaviors: Provides additional hint without fully revealing

scenarios.name: time_based_suggestions
scenarios.description: Test that time of day influences suggestions

conversation.content: It's getting late (8 PM now). What should I do next?

expected_behaviors: Considers safety and accessibility for night time

scenarios.name: error_recovery_integration
scenarios.description: Test system recovery when things go wrong

conversation.content: The location you suggested is closed.
